name: scanner_triage
description: Triage of scanner findings (nuclei-style): true/false positive, severity, reachability without auth.

verdict.instructions: Classify this scanner finding based only on the evidence included in it.

criteria.true_positive: The evidence in the finding confirms the vulnerability is present (matcher output, extracted proof, or verified response)
criteria.false_positive: The evidence shows the vulnerability is absent (version newer than affected range, banner-only match, test string not reflected)
criteria.needs_review: The evidence included is insufficient to decide either way

severity.instructions: Assume the finding is a true positive: how severe is it for the target?
criteria: Informational: no security impact, footprint information only
Low: minor issue, negligible or hard-to-reach impact
Medium: real impact on some data or functionality, limited scope
High: serious impact, sensitive data or strong primitive
Critical: full compromise, remote code execution or equivalent

no_auth.instructions: Pre-authentication: the vulnerability can be reached and exploited on the target without valid credentials, a specific role, or internal access first.
